model: A read-only deterministic projection state machine over the V13.1 canonical event schema. It provides idempotent ingestion, canonical/finalized checkpoint tracking, bounded reorg rollback and recovery semantics without protocol execution authority.
invariants: replaying an identical canonical record is idempotent
a conflicting replay with the same record ID fails closed
canonical checkpoints never regress during ordinary ingestion
rollback cannot cross the finalized checkpoint
rollback clears canonical block-hash claims above the selected ancestor
a replacement canonical branch can occupy rolled-back heights
orphaned records cannot be promoted to finalized
indexer state grants no execution, custody, mint, burn or settlement authority
qualification_tests: identical replay returns false without mutation
bounded rollback restores an ancestor and accepts a replacement branch
rollback beyond the configured depth is rejected
canonical records can advance through finalized lifecycle
